# Qwen3-Embedding-4B-W4A16-G128

GPTQ Quantized [Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B) with [THUIR/T2Ranking](https://huggingface.co/datasets/THUIR/T2Ranking) and [m-a-p/COIG-CQIA](huggingface.co/datasets/m-a-p/COIG-CQIA) for calibration set.

## What's the benefit?

VRAM Usage: `17430M` -> `11000M` (w/o FA2).

## What's the cost?

`~0.72%` lost in C-MTEB.

Evaluation performed with [official code](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-Embedding).

## How to use it?

`pip install compressed-tensors optimum` and `auto-gptq` / `gptqmodel`, then goto [the official usage guide](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B#transformers-usage).
